_note: Registration snippet — AUTHORING-BRIEF 'Registration protocol'. Content
agents do not touch content/manifest.js, content/manifest.json or
server/lib/rules.php; the integrator applies this and deletes the file.
ORDER MATTERS: r11 is the ELEVENTH region of the fabulae track and must
sit after r10 in the manifest's regions array — js/app.js regionIndex()
reads that order and feeds it to the phase engine as the ONE difficulty
input (DESIGN §6). Applied out of order, Regiō XI plays easier than
Regiō X. APPLY AFTER the R7-R9 snippets, which a parallel author owns,
and after r10.
r11 is a DUEL region (three phases: caterva 3/26 + clamor 4/32 + fuga
2/22, hp 9 over 80 phase-seconds). The extra hit over r10 is in CLĀMOR
on purpose: clāmor is the phase that reads sentences, and this region's
sentences — purpose, result and indirect question — are the point of it.
Legacy single-phase tuning in the content file is hp 9 / 60 s, kept
because rules.php reads it and because a client without
js/boss-phases.js must still be able to fight (same shape as r10's
bossMinMs 15000 — the same floor every duel region uses, unchanged from
r10. The fight is longer than r10's, and a longer fight cannot be forged
FASTER: the phase seconds are ceilings, not durations, so the floor does
not move.
quizKey carries the same three keys per row as r03-r06 and r10:
rules.php stores {q, a}, and `correct` is always 0 against the boss.quiz
order in content/fabulae-r11.js. Every word is a vocabulary entry WITH a
picture in the capitulum named by `from`, which is what app.js
bossWords() needs. `Mors` is deliberately NOT among them — the quiz is a
picture test and hers is a person, the same call that keeps her out of
SONUS (see content/_ledger-fabulae-part2.md, the MORS section).
r11 is a NEW region: its content id IS its progressId, so it needs no
entry in rule_region_aliases().
XP mirrors r05/r06/r10 exactly (fight 30, quiz 10 each, <=1 wrong of 5
passes); the step XP is left to RULE_DEFAULT_STEP_XP as in every earlier
fabulae region.
